response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT sites.riskeval, SUM(scans.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(scans.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(group_rates.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(group_rates.rate - benchmark.rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark FROM group_rates CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE group_rates.rate > benchmark.rate;
